_README: Central registry of hard-coded CLE hyperparameters. Every per-layer margin schedule used
by cle-a.py / cle-p.py / cle-p-star.py / experiments/* lives here and nowhere else.
Select one with --margin_schedule <name>; it supplies both --layers and --layer_margins,
and the run tag becomes 'margin<name>' instead of a SHA1 digest.
layers        end-exclusive window string, same syntax as --layers ('11-18', '10,14,20')
margins       one value per layer in `layers`, in layer order (length is validated on load)
optimized_for 'cle-a' | 'cle-p' | 'unknown' | null. Scripts WARN when this contradicts the
variant being run; null means method-independent (e.g. derived from data).
provenance    where the numbers came from, in enough detail to re-derive or re-request
generator     script that reproduces them, when one exists
legacy_digest pre-registry marginvec tag, so historical filenames stay decodable
Names use hyphens, never underscores: '_' is the field separator in build_run_tag().

hlmean.provenance: computed from the harmless training distribution: m_l = |mean(harmless probe scores at layer l)|. No Bayesian optimization, no GPU. Method-independent by construction.

paper-fig7b.provenance: hand-transcribed from Figure 7b of arXiv 2605.21706 (Piras et al., Latent-space Attacks for Refusal Evasion in Language Models). Not reproducible from this repo.
paper-fig7b.note: Figure 7 is the CLE-A schedule, not CLE-P: panel (a) spans 2.5-4.0 and Table 3 gives LLaMA2-7B CLE-A m=3.1 vs CLE-P m=1.6, so a +/-0.1 walk seeded at 1.6 cannot reach that range. Runs that used this as a CLE-P baseline are therefore method-mismatched. Untested alternative: Table 3's shared CLE-P m=1.3. See RESUME.md:71-74.

bo-external.provenance: Bayesian-optimized margins for llama3-8b, supplied externally on 2026-08-05. Confirmed by the provider on 2026-08-06 to have been optimized against CLE-A.
bo-external.note: Resolved from 'unknown' to 'cle-a' on 2026-08-06. Runs that used this schedule under CLE-P (experiments/results/RESULTS_SUMMARY.md, StrongREJECT re-run) are therefore method-mismatched and cannot be read as a fair CLE-P result. The empirical signal agreed with this before the confirmation arrived: bo-external gained +14.5 ASR under CLE-A and lost ASR and StrongREJECT under CLE-P.
